headline: Engineering Manager | Software Architect
summary: Strategic Engineering Manager with over 11 years of experience in the Nepal IT sector, specializing in building high-performance engineering cultures and scalable cloud architectures. Successfully transitioned from a Senior Individual Contributor role into leadership, with a proven track record of managing cross-functional teams at Leapfrog and Cotiviti. Expert in Agile methodologies, delivery management, and mentoring technical talent to achieve organizational goals.

experiences.title: Engineering Manager
description: Oversee delivery for three cross-functional engineering teams (20+ engineers) focused on US-based healthcare and fintech products.
Transitioned from a Lead Engineer role to full-time Management, focusing on sprint planning, resource allocation, and stakeholder management.
Implemented a structured mentorship program that reduced onboarding time for junior developers by 30%.
Drive technical strategy and architectural reviews for microservices-based platforms hosted on AWS.
Collaborate with Product Managers to define roadmaps and ensure timely delivery of high-impact features.

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineer / Team Lead
description: Led a team of 6 developers in the Healthcare Informatics division, balancing hands-on coding with team leadership responsibilities.
Architected and developed complex data processing pipelines using Java and Spring Boot for large-scale medical claim analysis.
Facilitated daily stand-ups and sprint retrospectives, improving team velocity by 15% through process optimization.
Acted as the primary technical point of contact for US-based stakeholders during the transition of legacy systems to modern cloud infrastructure.

experiences.title: Software Engineer
description: Developed and maintained enterprise-level web applications using Java, Hibernate, and Oracle DB.
Optimized SQL queries and database schemas, resulting in a 40% reduction in reporting latency.
Collaborated with the QA team to implement automated unit testing, increasing code coverage to 85%.

experiences.title: Junior Software Engineer
description: Contributed to the development of mobile banking modules for major commercial banks in Nepal.
Assisted in the integration of third-party APIs for utility payment services.
Participated in the full software development life cycle from requirement gathering to deployment.
